verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents guarded rollouts, which progressively increase traffic to a new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions. The automatic-rollback half of the story is not shown in the guarded-rollout docs: it appears only as a pricing-page marketing line about Autopilot, and the documented rollback via change history is manual. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that a detected regression triggers automatic rollback, details on regression thresholds and alerting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically

citations.quote: A guarded rollout progressively increases traffic to the new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions until the rollout reaches 100%.
Your agents write the code. Autopilot ships it safely, and rolls it back if it breaks.
